name: bumble:futurespace
description: Coding and robotics courses for kids 8–14 using the mbot platform. Hands-on programming, real hardware, small groups.

skills.name: Course Information
skills.description: Provides details about bumble:futurespace coding and robotics courses for kids. Covers both beginner (Robot Explorer) and intermediate (Code the Machine) tracks.
examples: Tell me about the Robot Explorer course
What age is the Python course for?
How much do the courses cost?

skills.name: Booking Information
skills.description: Helps parents understand how to book courses, what's included, and what to expect.
examples: How do I sign my kid up?
What's included in the course price?
When do the next courses start?
What does my child need to bring?

skills.name: Curriculum Details
skills.description: Explains what kids learn in each course — from block coding to Python, from basic logic to autonomous maze robots.
examples: What will my child learn in Robot Explorer?
How does the block coding to Python transition work?
What sensors does the mbot use?
